queries.query: Tiruvallur Tamil Nadu official cadastral parcel map land records portal
queries.result: Found the official Tiruvallur District Survey and Land Records page, official district land e-Services page, Tamil Nadu e-Services destination, and TNGIS. The district page states that rural records and Tiruvallur urban records are online and that FMB sketches are digitized; no public parcel vector endpoint was exposed by discovery.

queries.result: Found the official Tamil Tiruvallur district site and the official Tamil Nadu land-record/TNGIS service references. The result supports local Survey and Land Records custody and public Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR procedures, but did not expose a safe anonymous parcel feature response.

registryEvidence: Tiruvallur District Administration identifies its Survey and Land Records department as implementing computerized rural and urban land records and digitized FMB sketches; its land e-Services page directs users to the Government of Tamil Nadu e-Services portal for Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR, A-Register, Patta verification, and Poramboke verification.
uncertainty: No safe native parcel identity, parcel polygon, service schema, or CRS response was obtained. The state e-Services host timed out on an anonymous TLS-verified GET, and the TNGIS page exposed a login/CAPTCHA shell. These failures do not establish citywide absence or lack of cadastral coverage.
